liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **El Paso** (2 reviews): Reviewer says it was too sad for Bobby to sing and believes the band shelved it afterward; Reviewer says Bobby forgets lyrics during this song [18][21]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 other source): Ambient microphones come on at 1:06 into this song in the combined recording [3]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer singles out this performance as a highlight [23]
- On track 1 Jerry announces in a mock-deadpan voice that Bob is having guitar trouble [25]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd87-01-29 t01 Finiculi Finicula Tico Tico Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd87-01-29 t02 Hell In A Bucket**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd87-01-29 t03 Sugaree**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd87-01-29 t04 El Paso**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd87-01-29 t05 Loser**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd87-01-29 t06 Little Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd87-01-29 t07 Brown Eyed Women**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd87-01-29 t08 Cassidy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-01-29.141938.fob.oade.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 144 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1987-01-29.167913.EC-7.OldNeumanntapr.flac1644**: source not stated; 20 songs; 129 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1987-01-29.140690.ultramatrix.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 18 songs; 140 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1987-01-29.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83284.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 140 min; rated 2.25/5 by 4 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording sounds great even though the show itself is mediocre [25]
- **gd87-01-29.sbd.bobh.10535.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 136 min; rated 2.45/5 by 11 [12]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard mix falls short of the standard set by Betty Cantor-Jackson's recordings; Reviewer finds Bob's vocals terrible and the band lethargic, with the show dragging; Bobby's guitar sounds out of tune and is barely audible in the mix [16][20][21]

## Around the show

- Chinese New Year balloon sculpture hung from the ceiling, leaving the taper seeing mostly Jerry's feet [2]
- Reviewer heard Otis had died shortly before the show, and says Bobby looked very sad up close at the stage [18]
- Reviewer says Bob's dog Otis died on the day of the show and Bob struggles throughout [19]
- Reviewer says Bob struggled through the show despite a recent loss, and it sounds painful rather than merely off [22]
- Reviewer says Brent stands out because he is compensating for Bobby's struggles [25]
- Reviewer calls the El Paso, Johnny B. Goode and Drums the worst versions ever [20]
- Jerry is more focused and comfortable than the night before, but Bobby is still struggling [21]
- Reviewer calls it a repeat of the previous day's mix of good and bad, with worse lows and weaker highs [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-01-29.141938.fob.oade.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Blake Jacobs; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC4/MK41 mics > Oade M118 > Modified Sony F-1 PCM; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM (unknown… [1]
- **gd1987-01-29.167913.EC-7.OldNeumanntapr.flac1644**: taped by OldNeumanntapr; transferred by OldNeumanntapr; source: OTS Balcony; Superscope EC-7 Cardioids (Near Coincident) >Sony TC-153SD Cassette Master >CDR >FLAC [2]. Also: Recorded on Superscope EC-7 cardioid mics and a Sony TC-153SD cassette recorder, only the taper's third show with that gear [2]
- **gd1987-01-29.140690.ultramatrix.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [3]. Also: Two sets of masters were combined to make the show complete [3]
- **gd1987-01-29.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83284.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Maxell MX90/Sony D5) [4]. Also: Soundboard source tapes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker [4]
- **gd87-01-29.sbd.bobh.10535.sbeok.shnf**: source: Healey ultramix: PCM -> Cassette Master > wav > mkw > shn [12]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead San Francisco Civic Auditorium 1-30-1987](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/san-francisco-civic-auditorium-1-30-1987) [29]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1987-01-30 San Francisco Civic Auditorium, San Francisco, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-01-30-san-francisco-civic-auditorium-san-francisco-ca-usa/) [30]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1987-01-28 San Francisco Civic Auditorium, San Francisco, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-01-28-san-francisco-civic-auditorium-san-francisco-ca-usa/) [31]
